name: PSLE Markers Route
finalMsg: You have arrived. Enjoy the event!

checkpoints.name: Main Gate
checkpoints.guide: You are at the main gate. Find the picture on the top right.

checkpoints.name: Guard Post
checkpoints.guide: You are at the guard post. Continue along the long path ahead to reach the General Office

checkpoints.name: General Office
checkpoints.guide: You are at the General Office. Please continue to Meeting Room 5 along the corridor, the room is slightly to the right at end of the path.

checkpoints.name: Meeting Room 5
checkpoints.guide: The room is to the right.

checkpoints.name: Canteen
checkpoints.guide: The canteen is to the left.  Do an about turn to go up the stairs on your right

checkpoints.name: Up the stairs
checkpoints.guide: Reach level 2 and turn left towards the Hall

checkpoints.name: Hall
checkpoints.guide: Facing the hall, you see 2 doors one on the left and the other is on the right. The Computer Labs are in your right.
